summary: Brown voted for the April 2024 supplemental to fund military aid to Israel and against all three November 2024 resolutions (S.J.Res. 111, 113, 115) that would have blocked arms transfers. His spokesperson affirmed his commitment to funding Israel's war, and he pledged in October 2023 to work with the administration to support Israel and defeat Hamas. An AJP Action scorecard reflects a 2% record, with Brown as non-signatory on ceasefire and humanitarian-crisis letters. Vote for Peace rates him Neutral.
